title: Vertiport Planning for Urban Aerial Mobility: An Adaptive Discretization Approach
method_summary: Integrated vertiport location and capacity planning with demand allocation over a continuous service region, formulated as a mixed-integer program on a spatial grid and solved with an adaptive discretization scheme that iteratively refines the grid where it improves the solution; case studies demonstrate scalability and network value.
relevance_note: Location-capacity planning with adaptive spatial discretization transfers to siting RAM airports and spaceport feeder nodes.
